heading: How to Enrol
step1Desc: Explore our one-year certificate programmes. Each listing shows duration, eligibility, provisional fee, and certificate authority.
step2Desc: Fill in the inquiry form with your name, phone, and course of interest. Our counsellor will call you within 1 working day — no commitment required.
step3Desc: Visit the admissions office, complete documentation, pay the applicable fee, and join the next available batch.
